## 2. Founding night

*From Q1:*

> So I finished my last manual report August 8th at 3:45 and asked gemini to write up a POC for a fandango scraper. 7 hours later I had results in google Colab. Moved over to VS Code over the course of that week and deployed my first version of that app to a droplet, which is still running today, 11 months later.

*Q11 answer, in full:*

> 10:45 that first night, but then 45 minues later it wouldn't scrape anymore.  It took 3 days to realize how static colab is and that the exaclt line of code was searching an exact date with data that expires 20 minutes after show start.  That was the first clue I needed more stability,, but by the end of the first week I had an actual application a monolithic code stack, but something. Then I knew for sure.

## 3. The name

*From Q7 (excerpt begins after the sentence carrying the full phone number):*

> 626, i think this part of the number is called the exchange, in northside buildings didn't get painted much so their old phone numbers stood for years 626 as I passed by, leaving the neighborhood each day for school.  I know people "rep" their area code, but this isn't that, 626 is the shape of homebase. The dirt and the asphalt that I played on, the place I always wanted to go back to when I was far. Where I was protected, challenged, and built.  Like I said before I never got much from school, as soon as kids became more aware the differences that a kid can't change started to matter more that number got used a lot more.  But not for incoming calls, for data. I had an outlet when I didn't fit in and it wasn't a shady group, but technology itself. How can I make this computer faster, how do i fix it now, how can I make this mine.
>
> I could always use Stage Productions. I love a good film, I am not a disney freak, but when I was younger I really saw myself in Stitch and when it was revealed he was project 626 I felt like we were intertwined. Nowadays I am feeling more like a Rocket Racoon, but I want to respect calling home. Not the neighborhood, the house, the heart.
